pelican.title: Pelican Test
pelican.subtitle: Ask every selected model to draw a pelican riding a bicycle and compare the results side by side.
pelican.page.started: Round started. Results appear as each model finishes.
pelican.page.emptyHint: Pick at least one model in the settings to start comparing.
pelican.page.noResults: No results yet. Run a round to fill the gallery.
pelican.settings.title: Pelican test settings
pelican.settings.promptHint: Every selected model receives this exact text, which keeps the comparison fair.
pelican.settings.targetsHint: Add the same model several times with different levels to compare them in one gallery.
pelican.settings.scheduleHint: Runs on the server at the top of each hour. A round that is still running makes the next hour be skipped.
pelican.preview.noConversation: No conversation was recorded for this attempt.
